title: Oracle separation of NP with BQP access from BQP with polynomial-hierarchy access

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard relativized quantum/classical/promise complexity models and imported Raz–Tal Forrelation, random-projection and query bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported background statements and full original bibliography retained. Every source-local quantum simulation, concentration/restriction, oracle construction and diagonalization proof retained, including corrected v4 Lemma53.

core_obligations: Bound how much a quantum algorithm can distinguish AC0-processed uniform data from a single Forrelated block.
Use the full source block-sensitivity concentration and Forrelation estimates.
Construct an existential oracle with a unary language in NP with BQP access and diagonalize all BQP with PH access machines.
difficulty_reason: Uses a non-routine indistinguishability bound for quantum computation on AC0 outputs of a random single Forrelated block, then constructs and diagonalizes an oracle language. The supporting block-sensitivity concentration and query arguments are bundled with this advertised main separation.

Direct QCMA/NP-poly consequences and technical support theorems are uncounted.
